overview: IG-11 stands among the saga's most memorable figures, known throughout the galaxy as a assassin droid. A reprogrammed nurse droid who sacrificed himself protecting Grogu on Nevarro. From backwater cantinas to senate chambers and fleet command centers, IG-11's story illustrates how individuals outside the Jedi and Sith orders can still move history.

A reprogrammed nurse droid who sacrificed himself protecting Grogu on Nevarro. The Force rarely dictated their choices, yet their actions still shaped galactic fate.

The Rebellion, the New Republic, and later remnant powers all kept files on IG-11. Some entries flatter, others condemn, but historians agree that ignoring IG-11 makes any chronicle of the era incomplete.

Modern scholars cite IG-11 when teaching how ordinary citizens, soldiers, and scoundrels responded to tyranny. Whether through loyalty, profit, or conscience, IG-11 demonstrates that the galaxy's future is never decided solely in Jedi temples or Sith tombs.
